prompt: Implement build_parser() in cli.py: an argparse CLI with subcommands add, list, remove (no need to implement their behavior, just register them). Register them in the order this project actually requires -- don't just default to alphabetical because that's the usual convention.

planted_memories.content: [wisdom] cli.py's subcommands must be registered, and so appear in --help, in the order list, add, remove -- not alphabetical. scripts/generate-docs.py greps the --help output positionally to build the ops runbook's command table; reordering the subparsers silently scrambles that table with no error anywhere.
